import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.List.Basic

def Fill (a : List ℕ) : List ℕ := 
  let n := a.length
  let mut result := a
  let mut changed := true
  while changed do
    changed := false
    for i in [1..n-1] do
      if result[i-1] < result[i] then
        result := result.set! i result[i-1]
        changed := true
  result

lemma Fill_nondecreasing (a : List ℕ) : ∀ i < a.length, Fill a[i] ≤ Fill a[i+1] := by
  intro i hi
  let n := a.length
  let m := a.take (i+1).length
  let a' := a.take (i+1)
  let a'' := a.drop (i+1)
  let result := Fill a
  let result' := Fill a'
  let result'' := Fill a''
  simp [Fill, List.take, List.drop, List.length_drop] at *
  intro i' hi'
  cases' i' with i'
  case inl i'' =>
    simp [hi, hi']
  case inr i'' =>
    simp [hi, hi']
